name: HeroLaunch — agent launch teaser
initialPrompt: Hero launch teaser overlaid on footage. An agent can plan/write code and call an API, but fails to sign up or pay for real web data — until today. Polished, Apple/Claude-launch caliber, transparent background, Apify orange accent, X morphs into a checkmark at the payoff.
scriptWithTimestamps:
00:00:00:00 - 00:00:01:11  Plan (Claude Code terminal, plan mode on)
00:00:01:11 - 00:00:02:05  write code (code writes on fast)
00:00:02:05 - 00:00:03:09  API (fetch line appends)
00:00:03:09 - 00:00:05:17  claude chat message (box reforms into the Claude window; user message)
00:00:05:17 - 00:00:07:00  "can't do that" response (slides up from behind the window)
00:00:07:00 - 00:00:09:01  sign up screen (big X)
00:00:09:01 - 00:00:12:04  credit card (big X)
00:00:12:04 - 00:00:13:14  hold (keep what is on screen)
00:00:13:14 - end          X transforms into a checkmark
